outcomes: The new hire can describe the organisation’s purpose and how teams work together.
The new hire can find key resources and knows who to ask for help.

The new hire can set up their accounts and core tools.

handoff.input: Design a workplace onboarding module for a new employee joining a small organisation (about 20 people). Cover: who we are and how we work; where to find things and who to ask; the few policies everyone must know on day one (code of conduct, data handling, health and safety); and how to set up accounts and tools. Keep it short, practical and respectful of a busy first week; each lesson should stand alone and be resumable. Exclude role-specific job training and anything requiring systems not yet provisioned.
outcomes: The new hire can describe the organisation’s purpose and how teams work together.
The new hire can find key resources and knows who to ask for help.
The new hire can apply the day-one policies to everyday situations.
The new hire can set up their accounts and core tools.
